kind: public-source authentication evidence and closed live outcomes; no account captures or private values

controlled_validation.scope: Authentication/session establishment and explicit local disposal only. No account-data request admitted; actual server expiry/logout/revocation were not tested.

sources.fact: Official DITO navigation links MyDITO Account directly to https://my.dito.ph/.
Public HTML shell references the listed first-party JavaScript assets. External vconsole and Google analytics scripts are not required authentication APIs.

facts.fact: Official site posts /ecare/webs/user/login and consumes top-level loginSuccess. Authentication observer requires strict boolean true rather than generic truthiness.
loginSuccess effect installs the site-owned session, conditionally attempts subscriber details, then redirects to configured success route.
Official GET /ecare/webs/user/logout succeeds only when its JSON result is number zero. Site clears session and returns to root.
Request prefix is empty, credentials are included, and auth APIs use same-origin relative paths. No alternate auth API origin was evidenced.
Desktop request error handling treats HTTP 401 or PORTAL-SECURITY error code as login-required and returns to the root sign-in route. No session lifetime is specified.
Official session cleanup clears auth cookies and its local storage. SIM Manager does not extract these values.
Sign-in input validation uses POST /ecare/webs/user/login/check; common config and legal content requests are separate from account balance APIs.

Protected layout getInCode may return to root when the site's logged-in helper fails. Ix2d.k requires an auth cookie and locally stored subscriber details, which are beyond this task's minimum authentication state.
Protected layout handleInitQry initiates account balance and usage bootstrap. Its account-view script is blocked rather than permitting those APIs.
Protected layout mount includes another subscriber-info guard and account bootstrap. Blocking its lazy script prevents those effects before the application's closed-state poll.

sources.fact: Protected Home chunk renders account balance/promo content. The /pto/home route loads this chunk and BaseLayout lazily after the login-success session effect, as referenced at umi offset 1249519. Both account-view chunk families are denied, while the source-backed success-route observation and site-owned session installation remain unchanged.

facts.fact: Official screen offers SMS and password sign-in. The production surface leaves all fields and challenges to the user.
Get SMS Code is a user click with default sendType one. Password reset uses sendType two and is excluded from the auth request policy.
SMS code control has a six-character limit. No current live SMS text/template was inspected.
Successful credentials may still require a user Privacy Statement and Agree action before loginSuccess effect. Server success alone is insufficient session establishment proof.

auth_request_policy.static_assets: Read-only safe extension paths at the origin root or under /assets/ and /lib/, excluding layouts__BaseLayout and p__Home account-view async JavaScript families.
auth_request_policy.denied: All other APIs, subscriber/customer detail queries, balances, allowances, promos, purchases, password reset, external telemetry, external debug scripts, router origins and wildcard origins.

legacy_audit.fact: Legacy URL remains the current officially linked MyDITO origin.
DITO sender plus six digits followed by authentication-code wording is a historical likely-OTP matcher, not a current verified SMS template or freshness guarantee.
Dashboard URL/DOM hints alone are not an auth-session success proof. Automatic OTP submission lacks the explicit user action required by Task 009.
Legacy private_mode false uses a persistent WebView profile. Task 009 uses an isolated memory-only profile.
Legacy settings persist subscriber numbers. New authentication does not reuse those settings or read the normal browser profile.
Historical pywebview framework, injected home overlay, watcher automation, dashboard/account scraping and cache behavior are excluded from the current native auth-only design.

unknowns: Alternative account/login result schemas and future site-build route gating remain unverified; strict loginSuccess true plus exact success transition passed the observed controlled sign-in.
Exact session lifetime, renewal behavior and any future auth source changes.

Compatibility of the restricted auth-only handoff with other account/site builds. Blocking automatic subscriber details and account-view chunks passed the observed controlled sign-in, without retrieving their data.

Router timestamp timezone, OTP freshness/account binding and universal SMS-template compatibility. One likely-code match was observed privately in a 20-record inbox; no SMS template/code was exported.
Server logout behavior on a real account; local disposal alone is not claimed as remote session revocation.
